meta.title: Renascor
meta.description: An open catalogue of digital editions of Renaissance-era written documents

entries.title: A Social Edition of the Devonshire MS (BL Add. MS 17492)
entries.institution: University of Victoria (editorial team led by Ray Siemens); print edition by Iter & ACMRS Press
entries.notes: A digital edition of a mid-sixteenth-century miscellany of verse and prose, compiled in the court circle of Margaret Douglas and later the Rutland household, with contributions by Thomas Wyatt, Mary Shelton and others. Diplomatic transcription, modernised text and scholarly apparatus, encoded in TEI P5. The original dedicated site (devonshire.unb.ca) is offline; the social edition now lives on Wikibooks, and the ~200 TEI XML transcriptions and witnesses (CC BY-SA 4.0) are archived at Oxford LLDS: https://llds.phon.ox.ac.uk/llds/xmlui/handle/20.500.14106/2587

entries.title: EEBO Text Creation Partnership
entries.institution: Text Creation Partnership (Universities of Oxford, Michigan, and others)
entries.notes: Keyed and corrected TEI XML transcriptions of Early English Books Online (EEBO) texts. Produces scholarly digital editions of early printed books. Access via EEBO (subscription) or open TCP texts.

entries.title: The Map of Early Modern London
entries.notes: A digital scholarly edition of early modern London, combining a gazetteer, an anthology of TEI-encoded texts, and a map. Includes links between places, people, and texts.

entries.title: TextGrid Repository
entries.institution: TextGrid Consortium (German universities and research institutions)
entries.notes: A digital repository for the humanities offering TEI-encoded texts, images, and structured data. Includes many scholarly editions of German literature. Free registration for some features; texts are openly licensed.

entries.title: Women Writers Online
entries.notes: A digital library of texts by women from the medieval and early modern periods. TEI XML encoding with extensive metadata. Free and open access.
